New in 0.1.4.2 - ground types (1.4 item 1):
- Four ground types: concrete, rock, clay and sand. Press M (or the button left of Tsunami!) to pick which one the right mouse button paints; Ctrl+right click removes any ground.
- Scene 6: rock coast, sand on the land and sea floor. Scene 7: sand beach and land, rock reef.
- For now the types only look different (placeholder colours, real art later). Friction, erosion and slumping come in the next steps and will use real values: sand erodes easily and slumps to 32 degrees, clay resists much more, rock and concrete never erode.
